trigger: Strangers at the sealed door (real). Then, past midnight, a mimic knocks (enc_ch08_door_mimic).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A knock. Five people on the step: a mother, two kids, an old man, a teenager with a broken arm. All grey with ash.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Nose to the door crack. Tail low. A soft whine. Their breath fogs the glass. Sick, scared, real.]

nodes.speaker: stranger_mother
nodes.text: Please. We walked from Sun Valley. They said there's a house that seals. Please.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Address? ...Okay, doesn't matter. Breathing? Okay. Injuries? One arm. Okay. Braith. Your call or mine?

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Then they're in. Decontaminate in the garage. Strip, wipe, bag the clothes. Then soup.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They come in shaking. The SEAL drops to 92% while the door's open. Worth it. Probably.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: I'm writing their names down. Not on a list. In a book. There's a difference and I'll fight you on it.

nodes.speaker: stranger_mother
nodes.text: ...Okay. Okay. Come on, babies. We'll find another one.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: [She doesn't speak to you for the rest of the day. At night she writes their names down anyway.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Past midnight. Another knock. Three slow raps. Then the same three. Then again, exactly the same.

nodes.speaker: hollow
nodes.text: Let me in. I have filters. Let me in, I have filters. ...Braith?

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Backing away from the door. Hackles up. Not barking. A growl so low it's almost silence.]

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: [Whispering] That's the Sun Valley mom's voice. She's asleep in the garage. I just checked her.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A woman's shape on the step. Minus fourteen out there and no breath. Her eyes take the light and give it back.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The door opens six inches. Something long comes through at the height of a face. The SEAL alarm screams.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: When it's over, the boy with the broken arm is hurt badly, and the hall smells like cold metal.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Two rounds through the plywood. A sound like a recording slowing down. Then only wind.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It knocks until four. It says your name nineteen times. At dawn: long prints on the step. And small ones.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The rain keeps falling, grey with ash. It's January. It'll be January for a long time.
